items.summary: Create frontend/src/lib/arbitrage.ts module exporting set_arbitrage(p1: number, p2: number) function that computes p3 = p1 - p2 and returns object { p1, p2, p3 }

In frontend/src/lib/arbitrage.ts, export get_arbitrage(p1: number, p2: number) function that internally calls set_arbitrage, logs the resulting { p1, p2, p3 } object to console, and includes a TODO comment for future payout and Merkle-root integration

In the existing order creation flow on frontend/src/pages/Products.tsx, after computing the order total, call get_arbitrage(p1 = total, p2 = mockWholesalePrice) where mockWholesalePrice is calculated as 80% of p1 (total * 0.8)
